articles.title: From Scan to Treatment Plan, AI Helps Close Breast Cancer’s Deadliest Gaps
articles.excerpt: Breast cancer is the most commonly diagnosed cancer among American women — yet the gaps in care are wide. A majority of women over age 40 skip the recommended annual screening. Radiologists are reading more mammograms with fewer colleagues. And when a diagnosis arrives, the tests that inform treatment can take weeks to return results.
